about.headline: The systems behind the paperwork: signing pipelines, ERP bridges, and the screens that run them.
about.summary: Full stack developer working across C#/.NET back ends, React dashboards and Flutter field apps. Most of my projects are integrations: getting one system's data into another's without losing the audit trail. The recurring theme is compliance-grade reliability — signed documents, reconciled balances, and a record of who did what, when.

projects.title: Invoice Signing & Submission Pipeline
projects.summary: Built and still maintains a self-hosted platform that signs every outgoing electronic invoice and submits the signed file to a national compliance gateway. What was a weekly manual export is now a morning command that finishes without supervision.
highlights: Submits invoices to the national compliance gateway and retries on its transient faults
Batch signing of up to 4,000 invoices per run in under a minute
Audit trail for every submission, from raw XML in to gateway status out

projects.title: ERP Integration Layer
projects.summary: Designed the message-queue layer that keeps a mid-size group's ERP synchronised with its warehousing, sales and banking feeds. Replaces a tangle of point-to-point exports with one monitored pipeline and a single reconciliation report.
highlights: Cut stock-update lag from overnight batches to under five minutes
Retries, dead-letter queues and alerting around every third-party call
70,000+ messages relayed monthly with zero silent failures since go-live

projects.title: Fleet Operations Dashboard
projects.summary: Built the dashboard dispatchers at a transport firm use to plan shifts and follow vehicles in real time: positions stream onto the map, and every route stays replayable for a full quarter.
highlights: Live map of 120 vehicles refreshing every 30 seconds
Shift planning for 60 drivers with automatic conflict warnings
Route playback for any vehicle over the last 90 days

projects.title: Group CRM Platform
projects.summary: Shipped the CRM that unified customers, quotes and support tickets across a group's five subsidiaries. Quote records now flow straight into their ERP instead of being retyped at every hand-off.
highlights: 200+ daily users across five subsidiary teams
Quote-to-invoice handoff straight into the group's ERP
Role-based access down to the individual customer level

projects.title: Field Team Companion
projects.summary: Shipped the Flutter app technicians use on site: jobs arrive offline, inspection forms capture photos and signatures, and everything syncs to a REST backend once coverage returns. Service reports stopped going missing in transit.
highlights: Works fully offline; sync resumes automatically when coverage returns
Camera and signature capture on every job sheet
Around 90% of service reports now submitted from the field
